Better #AIagents don't need more context. They need the right context.

Reliable agentic AI starts with #ContextEngineering, not prompt engineering.

The key?
➤ Give agents relevant information.
➤ Balance memory with real-time data.
➤ Avoid overwhelming them with unnecessary context.

Better context means better reasoning and fewer hallucinations.

🔗 Read Adi Polak's full article on InfoQ: https://www.infoq.com/articles/agentic-ai-context-memory-knowledge/
